Open6 of the 12 abnormal-period onsets are censored by the look-back cap; the small positive pre-onset estimate comes from them.See evidence · L11

Not supportedRisk rank elevated in the 60 min before empirical abnormal-period onsets vs month-matched ordinary running (PRIMARY ENDPOINT)See evidence · F1

OpenBand levels and abnormal-period membership depend on the Apr-May reference; the plant has not confirmed a normal period.See evidence · L10

WeakDirection of the point estimate consistent across June / July / August (each month too small to test)See evidence · F4

Methodology

KPI-derived abnormal periods

Stretches where the POC efficiency KPI was at or above the 90th percentile of its reference period. They are analytical labels, not plant events, and most coincide with load changes.

Label: KPI-derived abnormal periods (not plant events). KPI-derived empirical abnormal periods from the Phase 3 POC KPI. They are not plant events, incidents, deposits, rings or failures.

What the evidence shows

How to read this

The score is reference-relativeBand levels and abnormal-period membership depend on the Apr-May reference; the plant has not confirmed a normal period.Source: L10

The score is reference-relative

Band levels and abnormal-period membership depend on the Apr-May reference; the plant has not confirmed a normal period.

Many period start times are capped6 of 12 period start times are capped (start time capped at 6 h before the period, so the score window already sits inside the KPI shift). Served meaning: a censored onset is the look-back cap, so its window lies inside the KPI shift; the CENSORED slices are not evidence of precedence (Phase 8 F18); the UNCENSORED slices show no pre-onset excess.Source: Phase 8 censoring

Many period start times are capped

6 of 12 period start times are capped (start time capped at 6 h before the period, so the score window already sits inside the KPI shift). Served meaning: a censored onset is the look-back cap, so its window lies inside the KPI shift; the CENSORED slices are not evidence of precedence (Phase 8 F18); the UNCENSORED slices show no pre-onset excess.

The score is higher at low feedThe score is higher at low feed and during load changes; the Phase 8 load-adjusted analysis is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.Source: L08

The score is higher at low feed

The score is higher at low feed and during load changes; the Phase 8 load-adjusted analysis is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
